nodes.label: CI Workflow (compileall, unittest, eslint, JS suites)
nodes.rationale: Steps are always() so a red Python suite cannot hide the JS suites' status; JS suites are globbed not listed because the listed form drifted; npm ci pins eslint exactly so CI cannot drift onto a version nobody chose.
nodes.norm_label: ci workflow (compileall, unittest, eslint, js suites)

nodes.label: Unbalanced Markup Closed .shell Early (P0)
nodes.rationale: Two orphan closing divs from an unfinished edge-panel move terminated .shell 40 lines early, so Settings and Diagnostics parsed as children of body and rendered blank; the JS suites assert file text not parsed DOM, which is precisely why it shipped.

nodes.label: Dynamic Accent Rule (data-mode)
nodes.rationale: Green idle / amber paper / red live was declared in CSS but nothing in the repo ever changed data-mode at review time — a design system documenting behaviour it does not have is worse than one documenting less.

nodes.label: OKLCH-Aware Contrast Measurement
nodes.rationale: 144 of 175 text colours on Command are oklch(); a standard rgb/hex regex silently drops them and reports a pass it did not earn, so any contrast tooling pointed at this codebase must handle oklch.

nodes.label: Skip Link Blanks the Application (P0)
nodes.rationale: href=#s-command fed the router go('s-command'), which looked for #s-s-command, matched nothing and turned every surface off — the first tab stop on the page destroyed the view with no message and no recovery.

nodes.label: Ancestor Opacity Puts Refusal Text Below AA
nodes.rationale: 161 elements measured below 4.5:1, every one caused by ancestor opacity rather than a colour choice; three previous runs reported 0 contrast failures because no resolver composited ancestor opacity — the product's core refusal writing was the least readable text in the app.
nodes.norm_label: ancestor opacity puts refusal text below aa

nodes.label: Amber Has Eaten the Accent
nodes.rationale: data-mode=paper reassigns --accent to amber, and with a hard 2-position cap currently full paper is effectively the permanent state: 169 amber elements to 24 green, so permanent caution is no caution and the binding green identity shows only when flat.

nodes.label: AGENTS.md Pointer to CLAUDE.md
nodes.rationale: Deliberately not duplicated: two copies of an instruction drift, and this codebase treats a document that misdescribes the code as worse than no document.

nodes.label: Append-Only Content-Hashed Fact Store
nodes.rationale: Every engine writes facts under an algo_version and nothing mutates; decimal end to end, one authority per number, degraded paths must be audible, closed candles only.

nodes.label: Behaviour Change = Version Bump
nodes.rationale: Two generations of output under one label is the defect the whole store design exists to prevent; a behaviour change is a new algo_version, never an edit under an existing one.

nodes.label: JS Suites Assert File Text, Not DOM
nodes.rationale: A passing JS suite means the source still says what it should, not that the page works — behaviour must also be confirmed in the running app.
nodes.norm_label: js suites assert file text, not dom

nodes.label: ESLint as Bug Gate, Not Style Gate
nodes.rationale: no-undef catches names read but never bound (renderDeck's missing 'now' silently emptied the Setup Deck); no-redeclare caught two hoisted renderScoreboard functions where the later silently won. No formatting rule is on and none should be added.
nodes.norm_label: eslint as bug gate, not style gate

nodes.label: Watchdog Supervision (port 8422)
nodes.rationale: watchdog.py owns the scanner and API server and restarts them; a killed child's buffered stderr means _last_error() is not where it died unless the child runs with -u.

nodes.label: Write-Endpoint Test Hazard
nodes.rationale: TestClient drives the real app against the real store: test_system_restart forced _watchdog_alive open and taskkilled the live scanner 356 times. When a test forces a safety guard open, stub the thing the guard was protecting in the same breath.

nodes.label: Scripted-Edit Escape-Byte Trap
nodes.rationale: A patch script can land the byte an escape denotes instead of the characters that spell it; ripgrep then classifies the file as binary and silently skips it, so bytes must be scanned after any scripted edit containing an escape.

nodes.label: Hidden Preview Pane Does Not Composite
nodes.rationale: requestAnimationFrame never fires and screenshots fail, so anything the app defers to rAF appears not to happen; shim rAF and matchMedia before concluding anything.
nodes.norm_label: hidden preview pane does not composite

nodes.label: Lead-With-The-Answer Reporting Style
nodes.rationale: The operator is a trader, not a backend engineer: first line states what is true, plain-English why next, detail only if it changes what they do; never dress a maybe as a finding — an interval crossing zero means 'this hasn't proven anything yet'.

nodes.label: Ticket-Math / Engine Agreement Contract
nodes.rationale: ticket-math.js decides how big a trade is and re-implements venues.liquidation_price — the only thing proving the ticket and the engine agree about where a position dies.

nodes.label: Fact Contract (confirmed_at vs market_time)
nodes.rationale: The mechanism a neighbouring product could not truthfully copy: every fact records when it happened and when it became knowable, content-hash idempotency proves determinism, and rejections are as auditable as approvals.

nodes.label: Honest Before Flattering
nodes.rationale: Success is a forward paper record honest enough to justify live execution or honest enough to refuse it; the system reporting that no strategy clears zero is the product working, not failing.

nodes.label: Three Session Shapes
nodes.rationale: Long chart-reading sessions, twenty-second checks, and deep dives into Results/Diagnostics all happen; a surface tuned only for one fails the others, so every surface must answer immediately while rewarding the long dive.

nodes.label: Paper Trading Only
nodes.rationale: No order-placement function exists anywhere in the codebase and live_enabled is a hard-coded literal, not a setting; the interface must never imply live execution is available.

nodes.label: Sniper Brand Identity
nodes.rationale: The sniper/tactical identity is binding and follows from the name; design may reinterpret its expression but may not abandon it for a generic register. The specific reticle execution, typefaces and five-surface nav are explicitly open to change.

nodes.label: LEARN Surface & 40-Term Glossary
nodes.rationale: Exists because the product is headed toward an audience beyond the operator: terminology must carry its own explanation at point of use. Multiple design reviews found the glossary shipped while the LEARN surface remained an empty comment stub in shell.html.

nodes.label: Venue Derived From Symbol
nodes.rationale: BTC-USD → Coinbase spot, BTCUSDT → Phemex perp, PF_XBTUSD → Kraken perp — never globally selected; each venue carries its own fees, funding schedule, short permission, leverage cap and ISOLATED liquidation model.

nodes.label: Risk Authority (§9)
nodes.rationale: Position sizing, exposure caps, venue-derived leverage cap, liquidation-safety gate and daily-loss kill switch; strategies request, the authority approves, reduces or rejects.

nodes.label: Append-Only Build Journal (BUILDLOG.md)
nodes.rationale: Newest entry last; every session records what was built, decisions with the why, open flags and the determinism check result — including the duds and retractions.

nodes.label: Swing Engine & Composite Major Score
nodes.rationale: Fractal micro swings promoted through LOCAL/INTERMEDIATE/MAJOR by swings-of-swings recursion, then a composite score (margin, reversal ATR, held, volume, liquidity, impact, dominance) calibrated against the operator's golden BTC-1D data; v0.4 and v0.5 were recorded duds kept in the store.

nodes.label: Structure Engine (BOS/CHoCH)
nodes.rationale: HH/HL/LH/LL labels plus break-of-structure; swing levels admitted bar-by-bar as confirmed_at elapses so a level cannot be broken before the system knew it; break rule is close beyond max(1 tick, 0.05 ATR) and wicks never break.

nodes.label: Setup Detector & Playbooks (setups.py)
nodes.rationale: Fact-driven PULLBACK/REVERSAL playbooks: zone touch × regime alignment with explainable WHY assembled from consumed facts; rank is deterministic and explicitly not a probability, and was later retired when ablation showed it sorted the deck backwards at its own mode.

nodes.label: Execution Simulator (execsim.py)
nodes.rationale: Paper fills with fees, slippage and funding, net R-multiple accounting; same-bar SL/TP ambiguity resolves to SL conservatively. Gross-vs-net first showed costs killing the intraday book (REVERSAL +147.7R gross → -108.9R net).

nodes.label: Risk Authority Implementation (risk.py)
nodes.rationale: Portfolio-scoped single pass in strict time order; every intent gets an APPROVED/REDUCED/REJECTED decision fact with machine-readable reasons; later gained drawdown halt from peak and a data-health halt that fails open so a broken check cannot wedge trading.

nodes.label: Forward Paper Loop (live.py)
nodes.rationale: Polls every 60s, imports newly closed candles only, re-runs all engines idempotently and heartbeats at every stage so liveness genuinely means stuck; every setup from S10 on is out-of-sample by construction.

nodes.label: Dynamic Universe (universe.py)
nodes.rationale: Top pairs by live volume above a $3M floor with a 200-daily-candle history gate, point-in-time so a backtest cannot use tomorrow's listing; v0.2 fixed a 39% 429-refusal rate that had made trade eligibility partly a coin flip, and fails closed below 97% ranking coverage.

nodes.label: Venue Seam (venues.py)
nodes.rationale: The single place that knows what a market allows: shorts, leverage cap, funding schedule, ISOLATED liquidation model. An unrecognised symbol raises rather than defaulting, because guessing a venue means guessing whether shorting is allowed; liquidation_price raises on CROSS rather than returning an isolated number under a cross label.

nodes.label: Phemex Perp Adapter (phemex.py)
nodes.rationale: Market data only, contract verified live; perp round-trip fees 0.07% vs 1.00% spot reframed the setup drought — 317 of 358 missed setups were on timeframes uneconomic only at spot fees. Row element 2 is the previous close, not the open — a silent one-bar shift trap covered by test.

nodes.label: Kraken Shadow Venue (kraken.py)
nodes.rationale: Warmed, measured, never traded: shadow symbols accumulate candles, facts and setups with zero paper risk so the fallback venue is warm the day it is needed instead of 200 days later. The first implementation let Kraken win overlaps and collapse the tradeable set to three junk symbols — warming and trading are two questions, now answered by separate mechanisms.

nodes.label: Version Cascade Lockfile (test_version_cascade.py)
nodes.rationale: Any version move fails the suite until the consumer tuple is updated, forcing a deliberate look downstream; built after the S37 identity collision recurred, and it flagged cascades immediately in S41, S45, S50, S52 and S53. The fix for the recurring bug was never vigilance.

nodes.label: Fee-Aware Setup Gate
nodes.rationale: Rejects any setup whose risk is under K× round-trip cost, killing the uneconomic intraday book at the source instead of discovering it in the ledger; venue-blind cost profiles later over-charged perps 15.7x and screened out real setups until costs.profile_for became venue-derived and raising.

nodes.label: Confirmed Entry (TOUCH→CONFIRMING→VALIDATED)
nodes.rationale: A zone touch is a candidate, not a trade: a closed bar must engage the zone, close back out and close in the top third of its range; entry moves to the next bar's open and the stop to the confirmation bar's extreme. Fixed the 59% fill-bar stop-out defect and made the book measurable without creating an edge.

nodes.label: Maker-Then-Market Entry Model
nodes.rationale: Post passive, cross if unfilled after 2 bars — both legs load-bearing: the passive leg because break-even fee is 0.033%/side against a 0.06% taker, the crossing leg because unfilled maker orders were adversely selected (the trades that got away averaged +0.365R). A first variant claimed a maker rebate on a marketable price and was thrown away.

nodes.label: Cross-Fill Phantom Entry Defect (S50)
nodes.rationale: The crossing leg booked market fills at the plan's two-bar-stale entry price — 78 of 95 crossed orders priced outside their fill bar's range, never adversely. Two thirds of the book's apparent edge was fictitious and REVERSAL stopped clearing zero; the invariant 'no recorded fill may be priced outside the bar it filled on' is now pinned by test.

nodes.label: Hard-Coded Tick Floor Blinded 44 Symbols (S40)
nodes.rationale: TICK=0.01 hard-coded in three engines made the break tolerance larger than any move a sub-dollar instrument makes, so no close ever broke a level and regime read a permanent false RANGE; the tick is now derived causally from the venue's own price strings, and an unknown tick returns zero — the conservative direction.

nodes.label: Edge Statistics (bootstrap CI, edgestats)
nodes.rationale: Bootstrap confidence intervals on expectancy plus break-even fee; gained a confound guard tagging every slice with its engine generations, and was itself caught overstating the verdict 46% by stripping funding out of the venue-real scenario.

nodes.label: Factor Grading (factorstats)
nodes.rationale: Five-axis factor grading with redundancy detection: nothing recorded may gate a trade until graded above the noise floor. Its ablation retired the shipped rank score — a single 10-point HTF term outscored the whole 100-point composite — and proved a missing measurement must never be scored as a bad one.

nodes.label: Fail-Closed Data Quality Gate (quality.py)
nodes.rationale: Fail-closed market-data audits: known venue gaps degrade instead of block after the gate wedged the scanner for days on legitimate Coinbase voids; cached_audit() is the single shared verdict so two surfaces can never disagree, keyed by database path after a cache leak answered one store's questions with another's verdict.

nodes.label: Single Pipeline Roster (pipeline.py)
nodes.rationale: One declared per-symbol engine order imported by all three runners, replacing three hand-maintained copies that had silently drifted — cooldowns was in none of them, so a built, tested, documented guardrail read an empty list on every pass.

nodes.label: Cooldown Lockouts (cooldowns.py)
nodes.rationale: Stop-out → long lockout (the level was refuted), target/time exit → short lockout; per symbol+direction rather than per zone because a stopped-out zone's cluster neighbour is the same trade wearing a different id; derived from exec facts rather than live state so it can be replayed.

nodes.label: Nested Cycle Satellite (cycles.py, observational)
nodes.rationale: Litmus test: deleting it changes no trade — zero consumers by grep-proof; competing push-out variants are both published and labeled, never silently merged.

nodes.label: REVERSAL Strategy Record
nodes.rationale: The only CI this project produced that cleared zero, surviving four input changes — until the S50 cross-fill audit removed fictitious edge and it stopped clearing (+0.15R, CI through zero, P(>0) 91%). The remaining edge is something to test forward, not to trust.

nodes.label: Phantom Promotion Facts (S53)
nodes.rationale: held_candles — a run-time-dependent value — sat inside a content-hashed fact, so every cycle re-appended the same pivot: 178,115 excess rows inflating zone strength, which gates REVERSAL. Fixed by censoring held at its 90-bar cap and emitting only once the window closes, keeping the payload a pure function of the candles.

nodes.label: ApexShell Bridge (apexbridge.py)
nodes.rationale: Deliberate boundary — no fix-it button: verbs are allow-listed to audit and brief, because letting a dashboard button auto-remediate a trading engine is precisely the unaudited mutation the constitution forbids.

nodes.label: Indicator Engines (ma/momentum/volatility/volume)
nodes.rationale: Emit on state change only, never per bar, with Schmitt-trigger thresholds measured rather than asserted; recorded but consumed by nothing until factorstats grades them — an engine that never runs emits nothing to grade, which is how two prior engines died.

nodes.label: DPAPI Credentials Vault (credentials.py)
nodes.rationale: Keys encrypted to the operator's own Windows account; no route can read a secret back, enforced by an AST test asserting no server handler ever calls read_secret. A stored key does not unlock live trading — that gate is separate and closed.

nodes.label: Decision Provenance Panel (diagnostics.html)
nodes.rationale: Read-only searchable view of decisions and outcomes, root causes, missing evidence and per-decision rationale; ships an ?embed=1 mode so the shell's Diagnostics surface can lazy-load it in an iframe.

nodes.label: Verification Pack 001 — Swing Engine (swing-v0.1)
nodes.rationale: Operator grades engine swings Y/n/X against TradingView; 'Confirmed' is when the engine was first allowed to know it — two closed bars later, no repainting. The marks decide which calibration fix to take, and old and new versions stay queryable side by side.

nodes.label: Validation Report 001 pre-gate (exec-v0.3)
nodes.rationale: Scope caveat printed in the report itself: rules were calibrated with hindsight over this window — this measures robustness, not out-of-sample edge; true OOS starts with forward paper trading.

nodes.label: Validation Report 002 (exec-v0.4, post fee-gate)
nodes.rationale: REVERSAL n=14 PF 4.49 but minus-top-3 is -14.5R: the edge is 2-3 monster trades, tail-dependent and hindsight-calibrated — the BUILDLOG verdict on this report was that further knob-turning would be curve fitting and the next evidence must be forward.

nodes.label: Version-Scoped setup_id
nodes.rationale: setup_id embeds SETUP_VERSION ({symbol}|{tf}|{strategy}|{zone_id}|{SETUP_VERSION}) so cross-generation collisions are structurally impossible for new facts; a setup_id is unique per VALIDATED setup, verified across every version in the store.

nodes.label: Exit Manifest Collision Fix (risk.py)
nodes.rationale: Plain last-wins overwrite kept whichever exec fact the scan reached last, not the newest, so the settled equity curve moved with scan order. Fixed by keying (setup_id, available_at) with an explicit fact-id tiebreak and surfacing collision counts in rec.notes, because a merge that resolves silently is the whole defect class. 786 pre-v0.7 exec facts lack available_at and must keep the fallback path.

nodes.label: Manifest Field Split
nodes.rationale: The payload schema changed mid-history: older exec facts discriminate on manifest_hash, newer ones on execution_manifest_hash. Only both fields together are unique across every exec book; limit_price exists only on order facts.

nodes.label: Reach & Play Badge
nodes.rationale: One badge slot changed its question depending on the tab while a letter grade silently restated both answers. The fix keeps reach (engine_reach) and playbook coverage (weather.live) as two separate clauses with only the colour carrying the combined rank, because fusing two non-commensurable engine fields into one tier word would be inventing a claim.

nodes.label: Ledger Surface
nodes.rationale: Three books (engine paper account, hand-armed trades, operator exits on engine trades) shown side by side and never summed: they cover different windows and different capital, and manual.arm never consults the risk authority, so a combined wallet figure would be an invention. All money through window.SSFormat.money; era nouns exactly 'forward window' and 'recorded book'.

nodes.label: Card Rail vs Grid Rule
nodes.rationale: Use a card rail only when the operator can answer their question from the front card alone; use a grid or table when answering requires seeing two items at once. Rails additionally need peer items, an open-ended set, and meaningful order. This deletes the Results stat wheel because eight mutually-compared numbers belong side by side.

nodes.label: Version-Orphaned Operator Overrides
nodes.rationale: Because setup_id embeds SETUP_VERSION, a version bump re-mints the id and manual.overridden_setups suppression silently stops matching: a trade the operator closed for +$136.22 reported as $194.60 of live exposure. Fix keys overrides on the version-stripped setup id, which is a behaviour change requiring a version bump.

nodes.label: Fixed-Window Test Slice Hazard
nodes.rationale: Tests that slice shell.js by byte offset or first-match anchor fail silently in one direction: an undershooting slice passes vacuously. A green suite is not evidence the slices still delimit what they name; all six must be re-read by hand after each restructuring step.

nodes.label: Tactical Cockpit North Star
nodes.rationale: A HUD overlaid on a working terminal, not a dashboard with a tactical theme: dark by intent, high density where every glyph earns its rent. Explicitly rejects the generic SaaS dashboard, consumer-finance softness, crypto-casino neon, AI-landing-page reflex, and Bloomberg-terminal nostalgia LARP.

nodes.label: Dynamic Accent Rule
nodes.rationale: The --accent token rebinds to the operating state: green at rest, amber on warning, red in live mode. Every state-aware element references var(--accent); hard-coding green into a status-aware surface is a bug. Glow means participation in the current operating state, never decoration.

nodes.label: Olive-Tactical Palette
nodes.rationale: Never pure #000/#fff: surfaces are olive-tinted OKLCH near-blacks (chroma 0.008-0.015, hues 120-150), which is what stops the HUD reading as a Bloomberg terminal. Saturated colors cover at most 10% of any screen; the rest is tinted neutral.

nodes.label: Per-Symbol Venue Contract
nodes.rationale: Venue, shorts, leverage and margin mode are derived per symbol, never globally selected; venues.venue_for() is the only decider and raises rather than guessing. Revised 2026-07-31 because the previous global text had been wrong for weeks, and a venue contract that misdescribes the venue is worse than no contract, since it is the document checked instead of the code. Changing venue/fees/execution policy requires a new immutable manifest and engine version, never a hidden config edit.

nodes.label: Research Gates Before Live
nodes.rationale: No refactor can turn 30 hindsight-influenced trades into proof of edge. Paper-only until: 90 days and 50 closed trades on a frozen manifest, real costs reconciled against simulation, performance positive under stress and without the largest winners, no critical defect open, and a locked temporal holdout evaluated once with all variants retained.

nodes.label: Run Tests by Glob, Never by Name
nodes.rationale: A named test list is a second place to remember something, and it was not remembered: seventeen suites were added and none reached the list, so the suite pricing every position landed on main unverified while the doc said it was covered. CI now fails if the glob matches nothing rather than passing an empty loop.
nodes.norm_label: run tests by glob, never by name

nodes.label: PIPELINE Operational Source of Truth
nodes.rationale: Stages DATA, AGGREGATION, FACTS, SETUP, RISK, EXECUTION, ACCOUNTING; a red evaluation banner means downstream performance must not be interpreted. Critical market-input failures raise a fail-closed blocker instead of producing more facts, and every engine invocation records run ID, watermarks, fingerprints and counts.

nodes.label: WebAPK Install Route
nodes.rationale: Keep the engine on the PC and make the phone a careful window onto it over Tailscale HTTPS. Chrome's Install asks a Google service to build a real signed WebAPK; since the app exists only inside the tailnet the packaging server may not reach it, so the fallback is a local Bubblewrap build. Exposing the app via Tailscale Funnel was rejected outright: it would publish a trading cockpit with no login and live write endpoints to the internet.

nodes.label: Service Worker Scope Trap
nodes.rationale: A worker at /static/sw.js can only control /static/, so the install prompt may never appear; serve it from the root. The worker must never intercept /api/ at all (network-only, no interception) because /api/manual/open and /api/manual/live write fills and exits from a plain GET, so any caching or replay layer would resolve trades on a schedule nobody authored.

nodes.label: Offline Support Refused
nodes.rationale: Deliberately refused as a correctness decision, not a scope cut: for this product a cached price is a lie, and two endpoints resolve trades from a plain GET so an offline replay queue would write to the book unauthored. The offline state is a screen naming the failure rather than a stale cockpit that looks fine.

nodes.label: notify.py Fan-Out and Alert Dedup
nodes.rationale: Alerts must deliver from the watchdog's 60-second tick, never from the scan loop: every Windows toast spawned a PowerShell process and the scanner died at 254s with toasts on versus 1055s off, which is why SNIPERSIGHT_NO_TOAST exists on purpose. A notifications table keyed on (event, day, baseline) deliberately ignores the P&L figure, the field that varies across risk-engine replays, so one halted day cannot buzz eight times.

nodes.label: Self-Defeating Bracket Geometry
nodes.rationale: Total risk ~0.5 ATR sits inside the ~1 ATR noise of the entry candle, so 59% of stop-outs happen on the entry bar; and with risk pinned, the R:R >= 1.5 gate can only pass distant targets (median 6.4R against median MFE 1.53R), selecting for exactly the trades least likely to reach TP. exec-v0.7: 142 trades, 13% win, -102.8R. Nothing else is worth building until this is fixed.

nodes.label: Strategy Registry Proposal
nodes.rationale: Each strategy owns its own bracket and version tag so one geometry bug cannot poison every setup and a change to one strategy cannot invalidate another's track record. Per-strategy scoreboards and real Scanner Setup toggles fall out for free.

nodes.label: Pattern Recognition Engine (patterns.py)
nodes.rationale: A chart pattern is a geometric relationship between swings, and swing detection is the most mature engine in the system, so Finviz-grade detection is a patterns.py engine emitting pattern facts. Patterns are a fact kind consumed by strategies, not a strategy; a pattern with no break level is decoration and is not emitted; promotion to a scored input must be earned on retro-tagged outcome splits.

nodes.label: Options as Expression Layer
nodes.rationale: Every engine below setups.py assumes a linear instrument, so options enter as an expression layer, not a signal layer: the scanner keeps producing directional theses on the underlying and expression.py translates a thesis into the best instrument. Risk sizing becomes max loss of the structure instead of distance to stop, which fits a risk authority better because max loss cannot gap through.

nodes.label: Versioned Append-Only Fact Store Spine
nodes.rationale: One idea executed unusually well: a versioned append-only fact store with a strict one-way layer boundary, where each engine reads only facts below it. The confirmed_at vs market_time pair makes the backtest honest, and content-hash idempotency means re-running over identical data writes zero facts: determinism is checked, not claimed.

nodes.label: Waves Numbering Scheme
nodes.rationale: Two plans both numbered a venue milestone '4' meaning different things, and the UI quoted the stale scheme for months, telling the operator Phemex would land in phase 4 while the scanner traded 19 Phemex perps. From 2026-07-31 waves are the only forward scheme; phases are historical and new work never gets a phase number.

nodes.label: MAKER_THEN_MARKET Fill Defect (S50)
nodes.rationale: The crossing leg booked a market fill at the plan's price, two bars stale: 78 of 95 crossed orders filled outside their own bar's [low, high], never adversely. Two thirds of the book's apparent edge was the simulator handing out free entries, and honest re-simulation dropped REVERSAL from +0.266R (CI excluding zero) to +0.152R (CI through zero).

nodes.label: Edge Gate Answer: Not Yet
nodes.rationale: The 2x2 replay ran and revealed the measurement apparatus itself was wrong, a fifth outcome the gate table never contemplated. No strategy clears zero on honest fills, so Wave 2 strategy plurality is not unlocked: the correct next move is a forward record on a correct simulator, not more strategies. Two strategy candidates were already refused on their own evidence, which is the process working.

nodes.label: Ten Unstated Conventions
nodes.rationale: Strong conventions not stated in code, which any agent must be given explicitly: append-only content-hashed facts with algo_version; rule change = new version; confirmed_at != market_time; closed candles only; Decimal end to end; loud fallback; evidence recorded not filtered until graded; comments explain why with the motivating measurement; rejections as auditable as approvals; one authority per number.

nodes.label: Version Cascade Lockfile
nodes.rationale: test_version_cascade.py fails the suite when any engine version moves without its consumers moving with it, converting a silent cross-generation corruption into a test failure; it caught three cascades in one session and carries the reason for each bump beside it. HARDENING deliberately stopped listing versions in prose because the prose went stale six bumps running.

nodes.label: Five-Surface Information Architecture
nodes.rationale: The old UI was one screen doing everything badly (14 font sizes, 31 interactive elements, telemetry cosplaying as insight). Each surface answers exactly one operator question: COMMAND what do I do now, CHART is this trade good, SCANNER SETUP what is the bot allowed to do, DIAGNOSTICS is the machine telling the truth, RESULTS is this working.

nodes.label: Operator Overrides Excluded from Strategy Stats
nodes.rationale: A dragged level makes the trade an operator trade; it still shows in P&L but strategy edge is measured only on untouched signals, via dual STRATEGY vs OPERATOR scoreboards, so hand-tuning never contaminates the edge measurement.
nodes.norm_label: operator overrides excluded from strategy stats

nodes.label: Liquidation-Safety Gate
nodes.rationale: Refuse any setup whose viable stop cannot sit inside the liquidation price with a cushion (bigger cushion on thin books); ported as proven scar tissue from the old repo. Leverage sets margin and liquidation, never position size, and never widens a stop.

nodes.label: Factor Contribution Grader
nodes.rationale: Measures every confluence factor on five axes: fire rate, dispersion, contribution, pairwise redundancy (|r| >= 0.70 = overlapping signal), and outcome edge. The redundancy axis is the multicollinearity problem already solved and measured; called the highest-value file in the old repo.

nodes.label: Edge Significance Bootstrap
nodes.rationale: 20k-resample bootstrap of per-trade expectancy giving a 95% CI, P(expectancy > 0) and the breakeven per-side fee. Uses a deterministic LCG bootstrap with no RNG seeding, reproducible run to run, the only kind of bootstrap allowed under the project's determinism rule.

nodes.label: Adaptive Stagnation Exit
nodes.rationale: Hold time scales with what the trade is (horizon base x trend x volatility x counter-trend penalty, clamped 1h-120h) rather than a flat timer, with a minimum-P&L threshold so slow winners are not cut and a 0.7 stop-distance floor ratio deferring to the stop. Makes scalp/intraday/swing mean something: a horizon is a hold-time policy plus an exit policy, not a timeframe.

nodes.label: Differentiated Cooldown Manager
nodes.rationale: Per symbol+direction, persisted, with asymmetric durations: long cooldown after a stop-out because the level was invalidated, short after a target exit because the level was merely resolved. The distinction most bots get wrong: they either re-enter instantly after a stop or lock out a level that just paid them.

nodes.label: Do Not Take: 26-Factor Scorer
nodes.rationale: The 5,985-line 26-factor confluence scorer is the trap: synergy bonuses and conflict penalties are a free-parameter farm that can be tuned to any answer, four scanner modes quadruple the overfit surface, and an ML gate at n~900 with 26 correlated features fits noise. The old project's own factor_contribution.py exists because the file could not be reasoned about.

nodes.label: Confirmation Rule
nodes.rationale: Waiting for a closed bar to reclaim the zone with a rejection wick means the wick that would have stopped you has already happened, and it hands the trade a structural stop the market visibly rejected instead of an arbitrary ATR offset; the wider earned stop un-pins risk so targets return to reachable distances. Measured: same-bar stop-outs 57.4% to 13.9%, win rate 11.3% to 30.7%, and market-on-next-open eliminated the 39% miss rate.

nodes.label: Managed Exit Rejected by Gate
nodes.rationale: The managed exit (partial at 1.5R, breakeven move, trailing) made the confirmed entry worse (-0.017 to -0.171R): it caps trades that finally have a wide enough stop to run. §1.6 was written from excursion data measured on the broken entry, so median MFE 1.53R was a symptom of trades dying early, not evidence 1.5R is where to cut. Recorded plainly as the author's own recommendation that the data disagreed with.

nodes.label: 2x2 Attribution Replay
nodes.rationale: Entry and exit both change in the spec, so a single before/after cannot attribute the result; replay is cheap and deterministic, so all four cells run (old/new entry x old/new exit). It also caught a near-miss: a +0.322R cell was an artifact where 96% of profit came from three illiquid spot alts, collapsing to a zero-straddling CI once the top three trades were dropped.

nodes.label: Confluence Recorded, Not Filtered
nodes.rationale: v0.7 scores confluence on every setup and rejection fact but gates on none of it; score is hard-coded 0 so the schema field exists without a migration and promotion to a gate requires a version bump and recorded evidence. Evidence becomes a required filter only after the user grades it.

nodes.label: Five-Axis Promotion Criterion
nodes.rationale: A confluence factor is promoted from evidence to gate only when it clears fire rate >= 10%, dispersion, contribution, redundancy |r| < 0.70 against every promoted factor (one factor per information category), and outcome edge beyond the +/-1.96/sqrt(n) noise floor. The redundancy axis is the whole reason the old 26-factor scorer failed; it ships as a gate, not advice.

nodes.label: Version-Based Retention
nodes.rationale: Append-only is a rule about how the system writes, not a promise every byte is kept forever: what must be reconstructable is a decision, from the facts it consumed plus the manifest. Retention is measured in versions, not days, because a time-based rule would delete the oldest, most valuable history while leaving last week's superseded generation untouched; version-based retention deletes exactly what has no consumer. Nothing is implemented because 1.4 GB is not a problem and every deletion mechanism is a chance to delete the wrong thing.

nodes.label: Four Retention Classes
nodes.rationale: PERMANENT (setup/exec/order/risk/account/cooldown/universe/manifests, the track record, under 2% of the store), DERIVED-CURRENT (recomputable, kept for speed), DERIVED-SUPERSEDED (prunable only if no PERMANENT fact references it and it is 30+ days old), CANDLES (ground truth, cheapest to keep and most expensive to lose).

nodes.label: Prune Emits a Retention Fact
nodes.rationale: Any prune records a retention fact with version, kind, count and reason, because deleting evidence without recording the deletion would be the one thing this store has never done. Dry-run first always, VACUUM explicit and separate, and never prune while a scan is in flight.

nodes.label: Five Core Operating Layers
nodes.rationale: Market observations, derived market facts, trading hypotheses, trade intents, executable orders. No component may skip layers; a strategy cannot write directly to the exchange.

nodes.label: Determinism Principle
nodes.rationale: Given the same market data, algorithm version, configuration, and calculation time, the system must produce the same result, from candles through simulated execution; randomized ML must record seeds and versions.

nodes.label: Causality and Look-Ahead Prevention
nodes.rationale: A candle is not final until it closes; the system records market time, detection time, and confirmation time, and historical replay may not display facts before confirmation. The initial strategy acts only on confirmed facts.

nodes.label: Versioning Constitution
nodes.rationale: Everything that can affect a result is versioned; a version becomes immutable once used in a recorded backtest, paper trade, or live trade, and editing creates a new version.

nodes.label: Auditability Constitution
nodes.rationale: Every trade must be reconstructable from available data through final outcome: what data existed, which algorithm versions created which facts, why the strategy created the intent, what risk rules applied, why it was approved or rejected, what filled, and why it closed.

nodes.label: Risk Authority Independence
nodes.rationale: Risk control is independent from strategy logic: strategies request risk and the risk authority approves, reduces, or rejects. Stops represent structural invalidation and may tighten but never widen the originally approved loss.

nodes.label: Golden-Chart Validation Library
nodes.rationale: A manually reviewed library of ~50 BTC and ~50 ETH examples covering trends, ranges, false breaks, reversals and sweeps, with expected swings, levels, BOS/CHoCH, zones, liquidity and regimes, backing automated golden-chart tests.
